# f5xc_api_credential (Resource)

Create API credential user can request 3 types of credential for themselves. API_TOKEN, API_CERTIFICATE and KUBE_CONFIG. an API_TOKEN is an easy to use secret that can be send part of HTTP request header Authorization: APIToken <value> in the create request expiry can be set additionally. F5XC also supports renew and revoke of API_TOKENs. an API_CERTIFICATE is a password protected P12 certificate bundle document and can be used as client certificate. when sending create request, user can request with an expiry and password. F5XC Identity Authority (IA) mints new certificate with required credentials and is shared in the response as API Certificate. a virtual K8s kubeconfig can be generate with type KUBE_CONFIG. Create request can specify cluster, namespace and expiry with embedded user access with client certificate. request can specify name, expiry and type of credential required. since this credential inherits the creator's RBAC service will determine the user from request context.

To get more information about f5xc_api_credential, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/api-credential)

## Schema

### Required

- `expiration_days` (Number) Expiry in days Qty of days of service credential expiration.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name Name of API credential record. It will be saved in metadata.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace Value of namespace is always 'system'.
- `renew_trigger` (Boolean) Local Terraform trigger flag for API token renewal.
- `spec` (Attributes) Specification Shape of the api credential specification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `credential_name` (String) Actual credential name assigned by backend.

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `type` (List of String) Type Type of API credential, API credentials, kubeconfig or token.<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['API_CERTIFICATE', 'API_TOKEN', 'KUBE_CONFIG']`

Optional:

- `password` (String) Password for API certificate Password is used for generating an API certificate P12 bundle user can use to protect access to it. this password will not be saved/persisted anywhere in the system. Applicable for credential type API_CERTIFICATE Users have to use this password when they use the certificate, e.g. in curl or while adding to key chain.
- `virtual_k8s_name` (String) virtual k8s cluster name Name of virtual K8s cluster. Applicable for KUBE_CONFIG.
- `virtual_k8s_namespace` (String) Virtual K8s namespace Namespace of virtual K8s cluster. Applicable for KUBE_CONFIG.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_api_credential.example <namespace>/<credential_name>
```

### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<credential_name>"
	to = "f5xc_api_credential.example"
}
```
